decisions.reason: It sits squarely in our border and passenger-data capabilities and its demonstrated use across multiple government APIS schemes gives us strong feedback loops to keep improving it commercially.

The API still fits our compliance and passenger-processing knowledge base, so our absorptive capacity is good, but limited visible market traction keeps the withdrawal risk materially higher than for our strongest travel-security products.
This module leverages our established training infrastructure and security expertise, making it relatively easy to refine and cross-sell into existing corporate and public-sector accounts.

The system is related to our specialist detection and operational-security know-how, yet its higher technical and regulatory complexity means learning and commercial scaling are harder, so it remains a watch-list product rather than one to exit immediately.

It is closely connected to our document-verification and passenger-processing offer, and that strong knowledge overlap supports continued improvement and bundling with our broader travel-security services.
